name: Rina Shinomiya
main_effect:
[Your Turn] When one of your blue Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Tamer to give that Digimon +1000 DP for the turn.
[On Play] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 Digimon Card with [Vee] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
